# Instructions for AI agents

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) first; it is the canonical guidance for this
repository.

- Use Conventional Commits for commit messages and pull request titles.
- Build and test: `dotnet build Anvilboard.slnx` and `dotnet test Anvilboard.slnx`; frontend: `pnpm build` and `pnpm test --watch=false` in `src/anvilboard-web`.
